findings.issue: The 23 microsecond example described the extra 6 microseconds as per plan even though its arithmetic requires a per-call cost.
findings.discovered_by: Author secondary review during combined example verification; independently recomputed and corrected by root.
findings.repair: Changed frequency to per invocation; preserved distinction between one plan and repeated calls.
findings.counterexample: If 6 microseconds occurs per plan, the average over 32 calls is 17.1875, not 23 microseconds.

source_cautions.handling: Original archive preserved exactly; the new chapter uses a correct mathematical relation and does not repeat the erroneous index example.

assessments: Tensor ABI is defined as execution contract, not C++ binary compatibility.
Logical tensor shape is separated from stride, storage offset, aliasing, ownership, accumulation precision and workspace concurrency.
Fixed FlashInfer implementation claims are scoped to its archived commit; auto dispatch is not assumed to be selected anew on every invocation.
Performance comparisons include plan frequency, layout conversions, materialized GQA expansion, masks and output allocation.
Triton example retains descriptor-layout assumptions and base-2 LSE convention; tiling, int32 offsets and tuning amortization remain conditional.
QKV widths, RMSNorm padded denominator and residual fusion traffic explain semantics and actual consumer requirements.
additional_reasoning_checks: A transposed [2,3,2,4] contiguous tensor has shape [2,2,3,4] and strides [24,4,8,1]; index [0,1,0,0] maps to 4 rather than packed-layout 12.
If every logit error is at most delta, a top-two reference gap greater than 2 delta preserves unique argmax; equality does not guarantee it.
Packing and autotune break-even counts are equality points; strict speedup requires exceeding them.
limitations: CPU arithmetic and source/content review only.
No target framework/kernel installation, GPU execution, model inference or engine-performance experiment.
No assertion that finite local checks prove all input-domain correctness.
